stem: Six of twenty sampled plants in Zone B show interveinal yellowing on older lower leaves. Which note best preserves the evidence boundary?
choices: “Six of 20 sampled Zone B plants show interveinal yellowing on older lower leaves; photos and available root-zone measurements attached.”
“Zone B likely has magnesium deficiency because the symptom pattern matches a common nutrient issue.”
“The cultivar appears weak in Zone B because several lower leaves are yellowing.”
“Zone B plants look hungry and should be watched for additional nutrient symptoms.”
rationale: The strongest note preserves the visible symptom, its location, the number affected, the denominator inspected, and available supporting evidence without converting the observation into a diagnosis. A nutrient hypothesis may be reasonable later, but the record should keep observed facts distinct from causal interpretation until additional evidence supports that conclusion.
